entries.claim_boundary: This exact gate fixes the alpha_B=3 canonical scale, background momentum, selected Hamiltonian coefficient and complete linear canonical lift of every stored ell=0,2,4 correction channel and conjugate.  It does not itself evaluate D3C, K3, boundedness, causality, particles, positivity, unitarity or quantum theory.

lee_wald.statement: The declared Legendre convention gives the exact Poincare-Cartan form on the stored carrier; no new quantum norm claim is made.

resonance.statement: Third-order resonant source coefficients remain to be regenerated in this convention.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: The previously certified balanced correction has a complete action-normalized canonical lift.

causal_retarded.statement: No retarded compact-product complex is supplied.

smooth_secular.statement: The same finite correction rows lift canonically.

taub_maps.statement: The crosswalk enables, but does not evaluate, the cubic Kuranishi projection.
